claims.statement: Gothic Hunter is a playable Godot survival prototype with a finite three-act run, evolving weapons, wearable input, automated run checks, and recorded performance evidence.
Four-Way Kitchen implements a cooking loop and mutually exclusive keyboard, EMG, camera, and wearable input paths, while complete Play Mode and device acceptance remain pending.
The claw-machine prototype implements force-window gameplay, radial feedback, recovery behavior, and deformation experiments, with final scene and device integration still in progress.
Mole Rhythm implements deterministic offline chart generation, five-finger mapping, DSP timing, and multiple difficulty variants, with final glove and Play Mode acceptance still pending.
